title: Kagi Brings Back Old-School Search, One Human-Made Website at a Time
summary: Now Kagi has expanded its efforts beyond its Google-alternative search tool to curate a “small web” of sites driven and written by humans. Like the Kagi search engine, it’s a throwback to the old days of the web.
